description: Use for the current market read, one line per published page: the state word and summary line of the Full Read, the five areas (Technical, On-chain, Market structure, Sentiment, Macro), Cross-market, Liquidity and Cycle, each with its link, as printed on the site now. Choose it for one summary line per page and its link; for today's full briefing (price, forces, calendar) use get_bitcoin_today, for one area in depth get_area, for the five areas broken into 26 components get_market_detail, for the Brief headlines get_brief, for the Score get_score_for_day. Today only: for a past day's Full Read and five area words use get_daily_intelligence_brief with a date. Free, no arguments; a page not published at the moment is left out.
